purpose: the smallest board that still is a whole sensor: the SIN and COS curves over a full turn of the rotor, at any air gap, on a 16 GB machine

coordinates.model_origin: the rotation axis, at the top face of the stator's F.Cu copper
coordinates.z: z up, from the stator towards the rotor. Stator F.Cu top face at z = 0, B.Cu at z = -0.8

rotor.copper_layer: F.Cu of Rotor.kicad_pcb (one gr_poly: a half ring)
rotor.placement: copper side towards the stator, not mirrored, its copper face at z = +air_gap

air_gap_definition: stator F.Cu top face to rotor copper face (copper to copper)

TX.how: the two coil ends lie stacked at this point on the two layers; the terminal goes between them

2.source: the generator found no cut spot on this board; the layer-change via farthest from the TX copper (4.0 mm), of the two such on the far side from the TX terminal
2.how: leave this via out (opens the loop); the terminal goes between its two pads

1.how: leave this via out (opens the loop); the terminal goes between its two pads
